LanguageData.CC_Settings_Gods_Tip: One pantheon for the whole world. With Ideology, every faith's deities are real gods, with a domain read from their own words and the faith's memes and precepts; without it, each people has two or three gods of its age and its land. Rimfolk's peoples each have a patron of their own. The colony stands with each god at each home in words (wrathful to beloved), by what it does: a big harvest pleases the gods of the harvest, a sacred animal slaughtered angers the gods it is sacred to. Gods have ties with one another (rivals, lovers, kin, old wrongs) and natures of their own, and colonists swear by theirs. The Gods page is in the region window, under Peoples.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_Gods: A pantheon for the world, the colony's favour with each god, and the Gods page under Peoples.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GodRealness_Tip: How plainly the gods act. Believed: nothing supernatural; prayers, rites and omens read into chance, and the colony is sure it was the Storm-father all the same. Felt (the default): the gods act, but never so plainly that nobody could doubt it, and the news says "some say". Walking: the gods manifest openly, are named plainly, and can be spoken with.

LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Proud: Slow to be pleased and quick to take offence. Its rites let go and any scoffing gall it most, and it answers loudly.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Jealous: It wants to be the only one. Honour done to its rivals galls it more than most, and it forgets a kindness quickly and a slight slowly.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Generous: Easily pleased and slow to anger. What offends it is the hungry and the stranger turned away.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Capricious: Its favour swings both ways, fast, and fades fast. It hates to be bored and to be forgotten.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Wrathful: Its anger is easily woken and long remembered. Harm to its sacred things and scoffing offend it most, and it answers loudly.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Patient: Slow to warm and slow to cool, and it remembers both. Only a broken word truly offends it, and it answers quietly.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Playful: Quick to be pleased and quick to forget. A dull colony with no feasts, songs or games bores it, and a scoffer annoys it.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Cold: Exact and hard to move either way. It keeps account of terms, and a broken one is the only thing it takes badly. It hardly ever answers aloud.
LanguageData.CC_God_NatureLine_Grieving: It mourns something, and favour comes slowly to it. The dead left lying and its days let go hurt it most, and it answers softly.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Ordinary: A god like most: it hears what is done in its domain, and answers by its nature.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Archotech: Cold and exact. It bargains in terms and keeps every term, cares nothing for offerings, and judges only deeds that serve its aims.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Hunger: The void. It answers anyone desperate enough, always pays what it promised, and always takes more than was agreed.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Trickster: A trickster. It lies, swaps a blessing for a curse and back again, and loves nothing so much as a joke at a priest's expense.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Dead: Silent. A few still keep it, and its marks are found in old places, but nobody living has heard it answer.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Newborn: Born of the colony's own faith, small and weak, and growing with the colony's devotion.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Fading: No worshippers left. It grows fainter every year, bitter or gentle by turns, and would remember anyone who took it up again.
LanguageData.CC_God_KindLine_Imprisoned: Held somewhere it cannot leave, and it wants out.

LanguageData.CC_God_OldLore_Dead: Nobody living keeps {GOD}. Its standing stones are found in old places all over the region, worn smooth, and a few hermits still leave something at them and wait.
LanguageData.CC_God_OldLore_Fading: {GOD} was the god of a people that died out before the colony came. Its shrines are empty and its feast days are kept by nobody, and some say it still listens for anyone who would take it up.
LanguageData.CC_God_NewbornLore: {GOD} was born of the colony's own faith, out of what the colony kept doing. Nobody outside the colony has heard of it yet.
LanguageData.CC_God_NewbornText: The colony's faith has had no god of what it keeps doing, and so it has made one. They call it {GOD}, {GODOF}, born at {HOME} of what the colony kept doing: {DEED}, again and again.\n\nIt is small and weak, and it grows with the colony's devotion. The Gods page, under Peoples in the region window, has it.
